content_sections.heading: Indbank Relationship Manager and Dealer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 14 vacancies have been announced under Indbank Recruitment 2026. The recruitment includes 8 Relationship Manager vacancies and 6 Dealer - For Stock Broking Terminals vacancies. Category-wise reservation or vacancy distribution has not been provided in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Indbank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the educational qualification, relevant work experience and age requirements specified for their chosen post. The cutoff date for determining age, educational qualification and experience is 1 July 2026 . All prescribed educational qualifications must be obtained from a University, Institution or Board recognised by the Government of India or approved by the appropriate government regulatory bodies. Only experience relevant to the post will be considered for determining the required experience. Candidates should possess an MBA in Marketing/Finance from a reputed university. NISM certification or an equivalent capital market qualification is preferred. Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in stock broking, wealth management, mutual funds, debt instruments or related areas. The prescribed age limit is 25 to 35 years. Candidates should possess Graduation with NISM qualifications . A minimum of one year of experience in dealing is required. The prescribed age limit is 21 to 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Indbank Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Indbank Recruitment 2026 selection process is based on an interview . A Screening Committee will first screen the applications received to identify eligible candidates. Screening of applications Identification of eligible candidates Personal Interview Final selection by the Committee of the company Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for appearing in the Personal Interview will be informed through the email address provided in their application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Indbank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification requires candidates to submit copies of the necessary enclosures with the application. It also states that candidates must produce original relevant certificates at the time of the interview. Relevant certificates specifically referred to in the notification include: Educational qualification certificates Experience certificates Proof/certificate relating to age Other relevant documents supporting the eligibility details furnished in the application The notification does not provide a separate exhaustive checklist of every enclosure that must accompany the application. Candidates should therefore follow the application form and official notification while preparing their documents.

content_sections.heading: Indbank Relationship Manager and Dealer Application Form 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can download the prescribed application form from the Indbank website. After completing the form, applicants must submit it along with copies of the required enclosures. The application can be submitted through Courier / Registered Post . The company also permits candidates to send a scanned copy of the duly filled application and enclosures through the recruitment email address mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indbank Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility requirements can follow these steps to apply for Indbank Relationship Manager and Dealer Recruitment 2026: Visit the official website of Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Indbank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies in this recruitment, including 8 Relationship Manager posts and 6 Dealer - For Stock Broking Terminals posts.

faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the duly filled application with copies of the required enclosures is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Indbank Relationship Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an MBA in Marketing/Finance from a reputed university. NISM certification or an equivalent capital market qualification is preferred. A minimum of two years of relevant experience is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Indbank Dealer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Dealer - For Stock Broking Terminals should have Graduation with NISM qualifications and a minimum of one year experience in dealing.

faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 35 years for Relationship Manager and 21 to 35 years for Dealer - For Stock Broking Terminals. The cutoff date for age is 1 July 2026.

faq.answer: The compensation for a Relationship Manager is Rs. 4.00 lakh to Rs. 5.00 lakh per annum. Performance-linked incentives may also be paid depending on individual performance.

faq.answer: The compensation for Dealer - For Stock Broking Terminals is Rs. 4.20 lakh per annum, with performance-linked incentives depending on individual performance.
